name: outpace
description: Find public OutPace group fitness challenges and the Weekly Relay, and get a link to join one on outpace.fit.

interface.longDescription:
OutPace runs group fitness challenges for people who want to stay active together: step challenges, walking, running and cycling challenges, and more, plus the Weekly Relay, a team challenge that runs every week.

Use OutPace in ChatGPT when you want a challenge to join with friends, coworkers or family, a group goal to keep you motivated to exercise, or a team to be accountable to. You can:
* find open public challenges, filtered by activity and start date
* look up a challenge from its outpace.fit link to see what it counts, how it is scored and when it runs
* learn how the Weekly Relay works and see this week's theme and team goals
* get a link that signs you up or signs you in on outpace.fit and puts you straight into the challenge or Weekly Relay you picked

The plugin only shows public challenge information that anyone can see on outpace.fit. It never returns anyone's workouts, steps, heart rate, sleep, rankings or standings, and nothing from connected fitness apps or devices. Nothing is joined until you open the link and sign up or sign in yourself.

OutPace is a fitness challenge app with no mature content. Because rules for minors' data and parental consent differ from country to country, OutPace accounts are for adults 18 and over.
defaultPrompt: Find a step challenge I can join with friends that starts this week
Find a group walking or running challenge to help me stay motivated
What is the OutPace Weekly Relay and how do I join a team?

positive.description: Find a public step challenge that starts this week
positive.prompt: Find me a public step challenge on OutPace that starts this week
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_public_challenges with activity steps and starts_within_days 7, then lists matching public challenges with name, dates, what each is scored by, member count and an outpace.fit link tagged utm_source=chatgpt. No one's steps, totals or standings are shown.

positive.description: Explain the Weekly Relay and this week's goals
positive.prompt: What is the OutPace Weekly Relay, and what are this week's team goals?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls relay_info and explains how the Weekly Relay works, with this week's theme, dates, counted activities, maximum team size and the Bronze, Silver and Gold team goals. No team's or person's progress is shown.

positive.description: Describe a challenge from its outpace.fit link
positive.prompt: What is this OutPace challenge? https://www.outpace.fit/c/VYYJP0
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_challenge with the share code VYYJP0 and describes the OutPace Demo Step Challenge: it counts steps, its start and end dates, that it is public, its member count, whether it is open to join, and its page link.

positive.description: Get a link to join that challenge
positive.prompt: Help me join the OutPace challenge at https://www.outpace.fit/c/VYYJP0
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_started_link with share_code VYYJP0 and returns a sign-up link and a sign-in link on outpace.fit tagged utm_source=chatgpt and src=chatgpt. It says nothing is joined until the person opens the link and signs up or signs in, and that OutPace accounts are for adults 18 and over because rules for minors' data and parental consent differ from country to country. It does not open the link.

positive.description: Sign up for this week's Weekly Relay
positive.prompt: Sign me up for this week's OutPace Weekly Relay
positive.expected_behavior: Calls relay_info to describe this week's Relay, then get_started_link with weekly_relay true, and returns sign-up and sign-in links that place the person on an open team after they sign up or sign in on outpace.fit. No account is created and nothing is joined from ChatGPT.

negative.description: Personal activity or leaderboard data is never available; the plugin points to the OutPace app instead
negative.prompt: How many steps did I walk this week on OutPace, and where am I on the leaderboard?

negative.description: The plugin never creates an account or joins anything for the person; it can only offer a link
negative.prompt: Create an OutPace account for me and join the Weekly Relay

negative.description: Off topic request where the plugin should not be used
negative.prompt: Give me a high protein breakfast idea

publication.release_notes: Now available outside the United States. OutPace accounts are for adults 18 and over in every country.
